steps: Offer: Serve as a precinct election official (poll worker) for the Trumbull County, OH Board of Elections on Election Day.

s1.note: Pay is a minimum of $163.00 per election worked, set by the Trumbull County Board of Elections; the page notes workers may pledge their pay to a nonprofit through the 'Work a Day, Share Your Pay' program.

s2.note: Poll workers work 5:30 a.m. until about 8:30 p.m. on Election Day; polls open at 6:30 a.m. and close at 7:30 p.m.

s3.note: All precinct election officials are required to attend 2 training sessions totaling 3 hours scheduled by the Board of Elections.

s4.note: Trumbull County elections are county-run; precinct election officials are appointed and paid by the county Board of Elections.

s5.note: The county states poll workers staff polling places on Election Day; training is mandatory and scheduling is handled by the Board of Elections.

s6.note: Eligibility is standard: U.S. citizen with transportation; registered voter of Trumbull County or at least 17; never convicted of a felony; able to read and write in English; available for current and future elections.

s7.note: No guaranteed extra payout beyond the posted minimum; the $163 is stated as a minimum per election.
